title: Green Command Center — administration Home laboratory
mission: Prove the black-and-green command center design against the real /admin Home reading, in an isolated route. /admin is not replaced.

pixelComparison.metricStripBoxesPixelExact: all 6 (five metric cards + the decision card) — exact after the band contract fix
pixelComparison.divergenceCause: The rows below the metric band (mainRow, heroChart, rightStack, the five signal cards) sit 29px lower than in the reference RENDER, because the reference render overlaps: its cards spill 29px past their band and over the hero panel. Honouring "no overlap" necessarily moves those rows down. dx and dw are 0 on every one of them.
pixelComparison.residualDeltaCause: The 29px vertical offset of the lower rows (each reference curve therefore appears as a pair in the diff), plus real labels and figures differing from the prototype's invented text.
pixelComparison.metricBandContract: 5/5 assertions pass at 2048x1146 and 4/4 viewports satisfy it: cards equal the band height, zero spill, zero overlap with the next row, no card overflows its own box, no page scroll.

changes: Restored the reference's nine curves plus two mist volumes as GreenPlotTexture: an aria-hidden, role=presentation layer that takes no props, cannot read the registry, and is painted under the data layer.

Metric band contract fixed: --gcc-metrics-h raised from the reference's declared 116px to the 145px its own content needs, so cards fit the band exactly with no spill and no overlap with the hero row.

The texture's two green companion lines and the plot's green threshold rule are held back in opacity so the full accent belongs to the measured series alone. Geometry, hue, weight and every colour token are unchanged.
correctionPass.noColourChange: Verified by diff: zero colour, gradient, shadow, texture or light values changed in the CSS module; src/styles/tailwind.css and src/components/catalyst/** untouched.
